officialReview.evidence: The nine official TikTok v1.3 endpoint pages resolve under the authoritative domain and match the fixed names, methods, paths, resource families, and permissions recorded below.
officialReview.limitation: Public documentation does not prove the installed app's entitlement or sandbox account access; those remain authenticated release checks.

normativeScope.reader: Six fixed synchronous read operations with bounded single-page results.
normativeScope.writer: Three direct, explicitly confirmed, one-resource manual status updates limited to ENABLE and DISABLE.

requiredForLocalEnablement: fixed HTTP method and v1.3 path

synthetic fixture provenance and passing local contract tests
releaseOnlyChecks: authenticated sandbox verification with an existing documented environment
enablementRule.directWriterRule: Writer enablement requires one canonical advertiser ID, one canonical resource ID, a validated MANUAL resource-family assertion, ENABLE or DISABLE only, exact CLI confirmation, no redirects, no retry after a response or outcome-unknown failure, and no durable-state subsystem.

fixtureProvenance.statement: Fixtures contain invented identifiers and values derived from the reviewed response projections. They are not provider captures, credentials, entitlement evidence, or authenticated smoke evidence.
